text: S641's bounded public-source screen found no new receiver eligible under current no-cost/local/no-hosted/no-contact constraints. Seamly2D says it does not import DXF; garment.dev is a hosted app; CAD4Fashion advertises relevant apparel DXF modes but access, cost and product-use rights are not established without vendor contact. No candidate was installed or received product data. This does not clear or weaken any V03 gate. Existing CLO/OpenCAD evidence remains as recorded in the S638 matrix and S623–S640 packets; see E-G04-S641-EXIT.
